mechanics.validity_test: Signed CMP index,0x20 followed by JGE; values less than 32 continue, including negative signed indices.
mechanics.mask: EAX receives 1 shifted by CL; x86 masks the shift count to five bits.
mechanics.enable_nonzero: OR the mask into receiver+0x68 and return the mask.
mechanics.enable_zero: Negate the mask, AND it into receiver+0x68, and return the negated mask.
mechanics.invalid_index: Skip the field update and RET 0x8 with the incoming EAX value unchanged.
mechanics.null_behavior: No receiver null guard exists; a null receiver faults on a valid-index field access.
